mapper.sql: SELECT release_id, config_publish_seq, scope, tenant_id::text, object_versions::text, aggregate_fingerprint, status, requester_id, approver_id, effective_at, created_at FROM cap_config_release
mapper.select: INSERT INTO cap_config_release (config_publish_seq, scope, tenant_id, object_versions, aggregate_fingerprint, status, requester_id, approver_id, effective_at, created_at) VALUES (nextval('cap_config_publish_seq'), #{scope}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{objectVersions,typeHandler=cn.studykid.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.cap.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{aggregateFingerprint}, #{status}::cap_release_status, #{requesterId}, #{approverId}, #{effectiveAt}, #{createdAt}) RETURNING release_id, config_publish_seq, created_at
WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND scope = #{scope} AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid) ORDER BY config_publish_seq DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cap_config_release SET status = 'ROLLED_BACK' WHERE release_id = #{releaseId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cap_config_pointer WHERE current_release_id = #{releaseId})
